title: Perceived Differences in Activity and Experience Between Developing Software With and Without AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.27947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The fundamental changes in software engineering driven by generative AI will have profound effects not only on the number of available software engineering jobs but also on what software engineering itself looks like. As the career evolves, questions arise about what the skillset and interests of the next generation of software engineers will be and whether long-time engineers will continue to be attracted to the career. In this paper, we contribute to answering these questions by studying how software development with AI tools is perceived to differ from traditional development and how the differences are modulated by years of programming experience. We find that, in terms of programming activities, engineers report less talking with peers about technical problems, less decomposition, less searching of documentation, and less using a debugger, while they report more task switching. translated_title: 使用AI与不使用AI进行软件开发时活动和体验的感知差异
translated_abstract: 生成式AI对软件工程带来的根本性变革，不仅会对可用软件工程岗位的数量产生深远影响，也将深刻改变软件工程本身的面貌。随着这一职业的演变，人们开始思考：下一代软件工程师将具备怎样的技能与兴趣？长期从业的工程师是否仍会被这一职业所吸引？在本文中，我们通过研究使用AI工具进行软件开发与传统开发方式之间的感知差异，以及这些差异如何随编程经验年数而变化，来帮助回答这些问题。我们发现，在编程活动方面，工程师报告更少与同伴讨论技术问题、更少进行任务分解、更少查阅文档、更少使用调试器，同时任务切换更加频繁。我们还发现了体验层面的差异，包括更少的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 研究发现，使用AI工具开发软件时，工程师与同伴讨论技术问题、任务分解、查阅文档和使用调试器的活动显著减少，任务切换增多，且这些差异受编程经验年数的调节，这对理解软件工程职业的未来演变具有重要意义。
en_tdlr: Engineers using AI tools report less peer discussion of technical problems, less task decomposition, less documentation searching, and less debugger use, along with more task switching, with these differences modulated by years of programming experience.
